source_warnings.details: Abstract says search through March 2023; Methods says databases searched through 8 April 2024. Both statements were preserved.
Results/abstract describe 16 RCTs and 80,666 participants; Discussion describes 12 randomized trials and 69,024 participants without identifying a narrower subset.
Methods labels the tool ROB-1 but cites Sterne 2019 RoB 2 and lists the five RoB 2 domains.
Main text says many comparisons were moderate/low confidence, while supplied Supplementary Tables S2-S8 display High confidence ratings throughout despite major concerns/downgrade reasons.
Printed reference [22] appears to concatenate Wiviott et al. with a Nassif et al. citation and ends incompletely; it is preserved as printed in the reference export.
